title: Hold a gaming machine authorisation
what: Operate gaming machines only as allowed under an authorisation certificate for the premises.

sources.title: Gaming Machine Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 104(1) (current republication (R65, from 1 January 2026; Gaming Machine Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person operates a gaming machine; and (b) operation of the gaming machine is not allowed under an authorisation certificate;
